description:
Independent record label founded in 2024 by electronic musicians Xiroach (UK) and Egor Gerasenko (Belarus/Russia). The label focuses on creatively-inspired weird, unusual, and interesting music, with an emphasis on experimental IDM, glitch, breakcore, dark ambient, noise, and weirdcore aesthetics. An imprint for the founders' own work, the roster is not open to outside submissions.

In 2026, Q-REC was launched as a sub-label for more specific or experimental projects.
